title: Perfect complexes have quasi-coherent cohomology
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and K an object of its derived category [def-pc-derived-category]. If K is perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], every cohomology sheaf of K is quasi-coherent, i.e. K belongs to D_QCoh(O_X).

source.place: Tags 08C4 (definition-strictly-perfect), 08CM (definition-perfect); scheme quasi-coherence via perfect.tex, Tag 08E5 (lemma-pseudo-coherent)

proof.text: At each point take a strictly perfect local model and refine it to a bounded finite-free model. Retain its upper bound and the representation isomorphism: these data satisfy the definition of pseudo-coherence.
Apply quasi-coherence of every cohomology sheaf of a pseudo-coherent derived object.
